decision: Kew POWO accepts subspecies rank, lists variety rank as synonym. Existing Oregon State morphology explicitly uses varietal name and can be retained as source-reported evidence, with rank reconciled.
scope_warning: Oregon State source notes potential overlap/competing delimitation with Texas redbud; do not treat foliage claims as infallible species-ID discriminator without further comparison
preservation: Additive research only; photo sources and species descriptions unchanged
